title: AOT corpus page manifest
description: Metadata for one page in the AOT Tier 3 guard-rejection corpus. Mirrors the format expected by tools/aot_corpus/run_corpus_gate.py.

page.description: Page identifier; must match the folder name containing page.jpg + mask.png.

category.description: Which edge-case class this page exercises (see README.md corpus composition table).

expected_box_count.description: Optional: expected number of text boxes on this page, for diagnostics.

synthetic.description: True for programmatically generated pages; false (or omitted) for real manga pages. The gate treats both the same; this field exists so reports can distinguish them.

source.description: Optional attribution/source for real pages (e.g. chapter title, page URL). Required for non-synthetic pages if the corpus is ever published.

license.description: Optional license for real pages. Required if the corpus is published.
